h1: Office movers for New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania
lead: BRS plans and carries out office moves with clear communication and careful packing, so your team can get back to work with minimal interruption.
card_blurb: Planned, well-communicated office moves for businesses across New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
meta_title: Office Movers in NY, NJ and PA | BRS
meta_description: Business Relocation Services plans and runs office moves across NY, NJ and PA, with careful packing, inventory reports and clear communication.
overview: Business Relocation Services (BRS) has moved offices since 1987. We handle packing, loading, transport and unloading, and we plan each step so your belongings are protected and your move runs to schedule.

We work with corporations, small and large businesses, city agencies and non-profits. Our team includes people from moving, corporate facilities management, installation and accounting, so your move is managed as a project, not just a truck run.

benefits.title: Planned from start to finish
benefits.text: Every move is organized as a project. Movers, drivers and coordinators work as one team.

benefits.title: Items packed and loaded with care
benefits.text: We plan how items are packed and arranged in the truck so they arrive protected.

benefits.title: Clear, constant communication
benefits.text: Inventory reports and regular updates keep your team and ours informed throughout.

included: Packing, loading, transport and unloading of office contents
Turn-key office relocation with project management
Library moves and file room relocations
Computer, server and data center relocations
Inventory reports that track what moves and where it goes
Installation of modular furniture, shelving and file cabinets at the new site

process.title: Plan the move
process.text: We review your space, schedule and requirements, then agree on a plan and a convenient time to move.

process.title: Pack and protect
process.text: Items are packed and loaded in a planned order so they are protected in transit.

process.title: Move and unload
process.text: Our team coordinates movers and drivers, tracks items with inventory reports and unloads at the new location.

process.title: Install and settle in
process.text: We can install furniture and shelving systems so your office is ready to use.

who_for: Teams with libraries, file rooms or laboratories
Organizations moving computers, servers or specialty equipment

faq.a: We serve New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania from offices in Secaucus, NJ and New York, NY.

faq.q: Can you move more than furniture and boxes?
faq.a: Yes. Our office moving work also covers computers, servers, data centers, libraries, file rooms, laboratories and warehouses.

faq.q: Can BRS install furniture at the new office?
faq.a: Yes. We install modular and systems furniture, library and file room shelving, industrial shelving and pallet racking, and we anchor and level file cabinets.
